channel.title: Unreal Engine, C++, Python & Perforce Blog · Xiao Mao
channel.description: Unreal Engine, C++, Python & Perforce Blog · Xiao Mao

item.title: Local Integration of an AI Digital Human Interaction Workflow
item.description: Integrating speech recognition, LLM responses, speech synthesis, and lip sync in Unreal Engine, with local, cloud, and hybrid deployments.

item.title: Adapting AirSim Controls for UE Flight Simulation
item.description: Adapt frame-by-frame flight commands, yaw control, coordinate conversion, and AirSim interfaces for UE 5.6.

item.title: Retargeting Motion Capture to Robot Models in UE
item.description: Map filtered Kinect skeleton data to robot joints using structural proportions, IK, smoothing, and angular-speed limits.

item.title: Six-Axis Platform Kinematics and Ocean Recording Integration
item.description: Implement Stewart platform kinematics and motion processing, with Take Recorder, Sequence, and LiveLink sending for an ocean scene.

item.title: A Toolchain from Plugin Development to Release
item.description: Turning scattered development operations into dedicated tools for plugin management and multi-version packaging.

item.title: Publishing Markdown Images Together with the Article
item.description: Reducing manual work when moving articles by converting local image paths into publishable text that can be copied.

item.title: Managing Perforce branch workspaces and local caches
item.description: Organize branch switching with a workspace pool, separate server synchronization from offline directory adoption, and define cache protection and cleanup boundaries.

item.title: Driving Session Recording and UE Replay Management
item.description: Capture driving inputs and vehicle states, save performance statistics, and manage UE Network Replay recordings.

item.title: Creating Independent Multiwindow Interfaces in UE
item.description: Host UMG in native Slate windows with lifecycle, position, size, visibility, and DPI controls.

item.title: Robot Realtime Data and Three-Axis IK Prototype
item.description: An in-development UDP JSON and three-joint position-IK prototype, awaiting testing with the actual mechanism and real data.

item.title: Fixing Missing GI Across Multiple Views in UE 5.3
item.description: Increase the maximum view count from two to three in a UE 5.3 source build to address missing Lumen GI in a three-screen scene. Screenshots mark seven source changes; the engine must be rebuilt.

item.title: Source-built Unreal on Windows: a shared engine association
item.description: Register a source-engine directory in Windows with a batch script and use a shared association name for .uproject files. Includes the initial script, a deduplicated revision and registry precautions.

item.title: Unreal Blueprint parameters: references and display names
item.description: Complete declaration examples for Blueprint reference parameters, display names, abstract-class selection, interface constraints and passing Lambdas to TFunctionRef.

item.title: Cursor with Unreal 5.6 on Windows: establish the build first
item.description: Windows and UE 5.6 notes on build tools and extensions, workspace generation, IntelliSense, building and debugging, including the encountered unsupported cppvsdbg issue.

item.title: Fab submission notes: review the package and instructions together
item.description: Directory layout, .uplugin descriptors and FilterPlugin.ini configuration for submitting UE plugins to Fab, with Blueprint-only project compilation and delivery-package checks.

item.title: Unreal DataTable and JSON: validate before replacing
item.description: Use C++ to import a folder of JSON files into a DataTable and export each row back to JSON. Covers the implementation and considerations for both directions.

item.title: Saving Unreal editor assets: checkout, dirty state and results
item.description: The complete SaveLoadedAsset declaration and implementation, including package dirty flags, path conversion and save results. Distinguishes read-only file attributes from Perforce checkout permissions.

item.title: Breaking Level Instances in batches: bound the work and stop on failure
item.description: Break Level Instances in a scene with C++, including nested instances exposed during the process, and examine the loop's exit conditions.

item.title: Game formula parsing: grammar and operator precedence
item.description: Parse text formulas containing arithmetic, conditions and game attributes with UE C++, from syntax checking to the calculated result.

item.title: Everyday C++ choices: containers, sorting and value categories
item.description: Common sorting steps and stability, vector/deque/list construction and selection, container adapters and value references. Examples distinguish historical implementation notes from C++17 semantics.

item.title: Updating Excel by column names in Python: tuple keys and separate output
item.description: Select reference and target workbooks with Tkinter and update chosen columns using multiple matching columns. Includes log export, saving, composite-key collisions, worksheet selection and overwrite considerations.

item.title: Comparing directories in Python: start with a content-difference report
item.description: Compare old and new directories with dircmp, copy additions and modifications, and generate a deletion list. Explains shallow comparison, filtering and cleanup risks, with a report-only implementation.

item.title: Switching Perforce stream workspaces: preflight and failure boundaries
item.description: Use P4Python and Tkinter to select local stream workspaces, projects and branches and change Stream and Root. Covers sync -k, clean, progress, logs, local-change protection and failure handling.

item.title: Fixing UMG Size That Does Not Change During Rendering
item.description: When rendered UMG does not follow the output resolution, resize the PIE window to match it. Includes the project setting and its DefaultEditor.ini configuration.

item.title: Blueprint generic struct serialization: memory layout versus persistence
item.description: Reflected struct arguments, JSON parsing and safe persistence boundaries.

item.title: Managing Configuration File Exclusion During Packaging
item.description: Staging inclusion and exclusion rules in DefaultGame.ini, along with configuration scanning, file writes, and cache reloads.

item.title: Making a Rounded Rectangle with a Material
item.description: Build a rounded rectangle border with GeneratedRoundRect and subtraction between two rectangles. The example uses a 48:9 three-screen aspect ratio; other ratios need adjusted values.

item.title: Seeing Exactly Which Files Were Packaged
item.description: Disable Pak and IoStore packaging in UE 5.2 to inspect configuration, assets and plugin files directly in the output directory. Includes settings and directory screenshots.

item.title: Material Basics: The If Node
item.description: Explain texture RGB and RGBA outputs and the If node's comparison inputs through a material that disappears when dissolve is zero. Relates node connections to the opacity mask result.

item.title: Changing the Cache Path
item.description: Change the Derived Data Cache location in BaseEngine.ini and use GAMEDIR to place it in the project directory. Includes configuration locations and notes on removing old cache files.

item.title: The Keys to Runtime Animation Recording: Correct Bone Data and Saving
item.description: Read SkeletalMesh bone and transform data in UE 5.4 and write it to AnimSequence with IAnimationDataController. Includes frame rate, bone tracks, saving code and troubleshooting checks.

item.title: A Simple C++ MVVM Application
item.description: Create a C++ ViewModel in UE 5.5, configure plugins and module dependencies, and implement FieldNotify properties and accessors. Bind properties in UMG and create and assign a ViewModel instance manually.

item.title: Tips for Chinese and English Editor Settings
item.description: Keep English function and Details panel names in a Chinese UE editor while using Chinese tooltips. Includes global settings for finding Blueprint functions and comparing them with source code.

item.title: Quickly Creating a Map
item.description: Create a standard level without World Partition, add lighting through the Environment Light Mixer and create terrain. Includes interface locations and parameter screenshots.

item.title: When Only One Monitor Displays in Multi-Monitor Fullscreen
item.description: Investigate fullscreen output appearing on only one monitor in a UE 5.3.2 NVIDIA Surround setup. Compares Fullscreen and ForceRes and includes EngineSubsystem parameter handling and resolution enumeration code.

item.title: Calling a DLL
item.description: Place DLLs, libraries and headers in a plugin, configure Build.cs, and load and release the library in the module. Includes Dependencies checks and Windows header-conflict handling.

item.title: PixelStreaming
item.description: Configure Pixel Streaming and standalone launch parameters, then download a signalling-server release matching the engine. Covers Node.js, cirrus.js, browser access and default ports.

item.title: Synchronizing Exposure Across Multiple Screens
item.description: Customize LocalPlayer in UE 5.3.2 and set eSSP_SECONDARY for secondary players. Share exposure calculation data across screens, with an override example and project settings.

item.title: Setting Up a Listen Server
item.description: Start a listen server through launch arguments or the editor console and connect clients by server IP. Includes ?listen, -game and open commands with screenshots.

item.title: Seamless Map Travel
item.description: Configure TransitionMap and UseSeamlessTravel and expose a SeamlessTravel method to Blueprints. Includes PIE settings and observed HUD, PlayerController and WorldSubsystem lifecycle behaviour.

item.title: Custom Configuration with DeveloperSettings
item.description: Define project settings with UDeveloperSettings, including Config, DefaultConfig and ini syntax for arrays and Maps. Includes C++ and Blueprint reads and packaging settings for custom configuration files.

item.title: Fixing Missing Context in UObject Blueprints
item.description: Investigate GetWorld context when UObject Blueprints cannot access PlayerController or create UI. The example covers template objects, null Outer checks and objects created by an Actor.

item.title: Traversing Actor Properties for Sequence Recording
item.description: Recursively traverse Actor struct properties and set CPF_Interp so they participate in Sequence recording. The example runs in BeginPlay and explains when property flags change.

item.title: A Practical Guide to Streams
item.description: Stream Depots, Mainlines and branch types, with workspace switching between streams and projects. Covers Merge, Copy, external mappings and p4 sync -k when local files already exist.

item.title: UE Source Control Operations Guide
item.description: Connect Perforce in the UE editor, inspect asset status and changelists, and submit changes. Covers moving and renaming assets and fixing redirectors in the editor to maintain references.

item.title: Fixing Garbled Chinese Text
item.description: Investigate garbled Chinese text through server Unicode mode and client UTF-8 settings. Includes Windows p4d backup and conversion steps, commands and Docker deployment notes.

item.title: How to Configure TypeMap
item.description: Edit TypeMap with an administrator account to configure UE file types, writable files and exclusive locking. Includes a type table and scope notes for existing files, Binaries distribution and ignore rules.

item.title: Client Installation and Configuration Guide
item.description: Install P4V on Windows, configure connection environment variables and connect to Perforce. Includes client download, installation options and connection screenshots.

item.title: Common Client Operations
item.description: Create a P4V workspace, update and submit files, inspect history, and add or delete files. Covers reverting unchanged checkouts, comparison, cleanup, Undo and regular workspace mappings.

item.title: What to Do When a Stream Depot Cannot Be Deleted
item.description: Handle a Depot that cannot be deleted after its Stream is marked deleted, including commands to list hidden streams and remove history. Also covers streams held by active workspaces.

item.title: Making Conda Available in CMD Without Exposing Python from the Default Environment
item.description: Install Miniconda without adding environment variables, then run conda init cmd.exe by absolute path. Disable base auto-activation and check conda and where python in a new CMD window.

item.title: A One-Click Fix for MetaHuman Head Clipping During Animation
item.description: Adjust head-animation Additive settings for neck clipping when MetaHuman head and body animations differ. Includes settings screenshots, Blueprint batch changes and notes from UE 5.6 use.
